name: context-guard
description: Context runway gauge: warns before your context line with Compact, Hand off and Snooze

lineTokens.title: Warning line (tokens)
lineTokens.description: Hard cap for the warning line; the line is the lower of this and auto-compact minus the margin

marginTokens.title: Margin (tokens)
marginTokens.description: Distance below auto-compact for the line, and length of the yellow zone

snoozeTokens.title: Snooze step (tokens)
snoozeTokens.description: How far one snooze raises the line

compactInstructions.title: Compact instructions
compactInstructions.description: What the Compact button asks the summary to keep
compactInstructions.default: Preserve: current goal and plan, decisions made and their reasons, open questions, file paths and line refs touched, unverified claims marked as unverified, and the next step.

macNotification.title: macOS notification
macNotification.description: Also post a macOS notification banner when you cross the line
